items.definition:
an algebraic expression of two terms
In mathematics, (a + b) is a simple binomial.

an outstanding performance or achievement (British English)
The team played an absolute blinder in the final match.

a corpse
Medical students study human anatomy using a cadaver.

A set of integrated circuits designed to work together.
The new motherboard features an advanced chipset for faster data processing.

A freshwater fish; a plump person.
He caught a large chub in the river this morning.

A game played on a lawn with mallets, balls, and hoops.
They spent the afternoon playing croquet in the garden.

A pair of fine lines crossing at right angles in the focus of an optical instrument.
The sniper adjusted the crosshair on his scope.

A reduction in rank or status.
He faced a demotion after his poor performance review.

The action of a train or tram leaving its tracks.
The train derailment caused significant delays.

A person who has doubts.
Even the biggest doubter was convinced by the evidence.

a person who engraves
The engraver carefully carved the intricate design into the metal.

an indefinitely long period of time
It feels like an eon since we last saw each other.

a large machine used for digging
The excavator dug a deep trench for the new pipeline.

a ruling on a point of Islamic law
The cleric issued a fatwa against the controversial book.

a chemical element (F)
Fluorine is the most reactive of all chemical elements.

a game played with a ball in a square court
The kids were playing foursquare during recess.

a known or established fact or premise
It's a given that hard work leads to success.

a lump or mass of something
He spat a gob of chewing gum onto the pavement.

an early phonograph
My grandparents still have an old gramophone in their attic.

a traditional Louisiana stew
We had a delicious bowl of seafood gumbo for dinner.

a type of dog or a type of aircraft
The Harrier jet is famous for its vertical take-off and landing capabilities.

the state of owning one's home
Homeownership is a significant financial goal for many people.

a substance that causes irritation; something that annoys
The constant noise was a major irritant.

a device worn on the back that propels the wearer through the air
The inventor demonstrated a new personal jetpack.

An illegal payment made in return for a favor or service.
The politician was accused of taking kickbacks from construction companies.

A person who kisses; (informal) the mouth.
He gave his grandma a big kisser on the cheek.

Master of Ceremonies; a rapper.
The M.C. kept the crowd entertained throughout the concert.

in the middle of the air
The ball was caught in midair.

a member of a militia
The militiaman stood guard at the camp entrance.

a failure to communicate clearly
There was a miscommunication about the meeting time.

a warm tubular covering for the hands
She wore a fur muff to keep her hands warm.

peasants collectively
The peasantry suffered greatly during the famine.

a microorganism that, when consumed, is believed to provide health benefits
Yogurt often contains beneficial probiotic bacteria.

a person who is guided and supported by an older and more experienced or influential person
She was his protégé for many years before starting her own business.

a new trial of a lawsuit or criminal prosecution
The judge ordered a retrial due to new evidence.

a return to a previous state or condition
The software update caused issues, so they initiated a rollback to the previous version.

a medieval peasant bound to the land
The serf was tied to the land and could not leave without the lord's permission.

a propagating disturbance
The explosion sent a powerful shockwave through the air.

a sport involving shooting clay targets
He spent his weekends practicing skeet shooting.

a type of flowering plant
The garden was full of colorful snapdragons.

a sound of something soft and wet hitting a surface
The tomato hit the wall with a loud splat.

a small piece of interesting information or food
She shared a fascinating tidbit about the history of the building.

vasectomy
He decided to have a vasectomy for permanent birth control.

vicar's house
The old vicarage was sold and converted into a private home.

a big lie or a very large item
He told a whopper about catching a fish that big.

a strong alcoholic drink
Artists in 19th-century Paris were known to drink absinthe.

a common pain reliever and fever reducer
She took acetaminophen for her headache.

a type of snake; one that adds
Be careful when hiking, as adders can be found in this area.

a person who stirs up public opinion; a device that stirs
He was known as a political agitator, always protesting against the government.

a person who assembles something; a program that converts assembly language into machine code
The car factory employs many skilled assemblers.

a small white whale; a type of sturgeon or its caviar
Beluga whales are known for their distinctive white color.

a freshwater fish of the carp family
He caught a large bream in the lake this morning.

a coarse, woven fabric, typically made from jute, hemp, or flax
The old sacks were made of rough burlap.

the concentration of control in one place
The company decided on a greater centralization of power within its headquarters.

a tank for storing water
The old house had a large cistern for collecting rainwater.

secret information; a section of a newspaper for advertisements
He looked for a job in the classifieds section of the newspaper.

obtaining information or input from a large number of people
They used crowdsourcing to fund their new product development.

the protective layer of skin at the base of a fingernail or toenail
She pushed back her cuticles during her manicure.

the use of electronic communication to bully a person
Schools are implementing programs to prevent cyberbullying among students.

a line in a newspaper article stating where and when it was written; the International Date Line
The article had a Washington D.C. dateline.

an expert on diet and nutrition
She consulted a dietitian to help her plan a healthy eating regimen.

a state of confusion about one's bearings or situation
He experienced a feeling of disorientation after waking up in an unfamiliar room.

concern for the protection of the natural environment
Environmentalism has become a major political issue.

an artistic print produced by etching
The museum displayed several beautiful etchings from the 18th century.
